usage: Usually refers to collectible cards, especially trading cards or game cards, not just any ordinary card.
Common in hobby talk and youth culture; you can use it when talking about buying, swapping, or collecting card sets.
As a noun, it often appears after verbs like 睇、買、抽、換、儲 to describe card-collecting activities.
For beginners, it is a niche hobby word, so the meaning depends a lot on context; in casual speech, people may also just say 卡.
